text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we have an emergency...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
Behold the pride of our shopping street: the jumbo hot dog!
It's a whopping 10 meters long!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Beautiful...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Can't you tell?
Despite being that long, it's baked to be so magnificently straight...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text: "Hey there, young lady! If you wanna eat, eat as much as you like!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
It's a masterpiece made with the meat, vegetables, and bread our shopping district is proud of!
I was just about to slice it up for everyone—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?!
choice_data_list: Whoa, whoa, whoa, let's calm down for a second, okay?!
Once Daitaku Helios gets like this, there's no stopping her...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
Umm, haha... sorry, little lady.
We're serving the shopping street customers too, you see.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Is that so?
That is truly unfortunate.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —However, to cut up this hot dog—which can only be described as a divine straightaway—into pieces... Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Here you go, this one's for you, young lady!
Savor every bite!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Those beautiful lines cut into shreds...
...Delicious... Going straight is... delicious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nibbling away at her single hot dog,
Calstone Light O brooded in frustration.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "Naturally. It would be unthinkable to miss such an artistic straight."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
AHAHA, you're a funny one, little missy!
Alright then, if you can eat it, don't hold back, dig right in!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Now then, once more... Here goes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A 10-meter hot dog placed across a long row of tables.
She began devouring that beautiful straight line from one end.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, looks like something super fun just started up!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing!
Big sis is such a glutton!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
Wahaha, you guys sure have great appetites! Come on everyone,
I'll cook up more, so eat to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That was a wonderful hot dog. Please continue to grill them straight and true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O polished off a 10-meter hot dog all by herself.
The legend of that feat was recounted along the shopping street for years to come.
